title: Demo version
body:
The app is well-designed, intuitive, and very easy to use — I genuinely enjoyed it at first. However, it only works properly for about a week, after which it essentially stops functioning unless you purchase the Pro version.

Because of this, it feels less like a full-featured app and more like a trial or demo version. It would be much fairer and more transparent if this limitation were clearly communicated upfront. Overall, the concept and execution are good, but the restrictions are disappointing.
author: Denok82
